selection.description: Quota 1 ranks eligible applicants with convertible qualifications by their converted upper-secondary GPA.
AAU's current general quota-2 rules consider grades in the required subjects; the programme's 2027 quota split and detailed ranking are not yet published.
Quota 2 also considers up to 12 months of documented relevant work experience or education. Motivational letters and recommendations are not considered relevant.

requirements.label: A qualifying upper-secondary examination

officialWording.text: International Baccalaureate (IB) med IB-Course Result på mindst 18 point sidestilles med en gymnasial eksamen, hvis ansøgeren har opnået mindst karakteren 3 i hvert af de 6 fag, der indgår i IB-forløbet. Endvidere skal ansøgeren have gennemført enkeltfag på gymnasialt niveau svarende til overbygning, jf. reglerne om overbygning i højere forberedelseseksamen (hf-eksamen) i lov om gymnasiale uddannelser.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you. The Danish Agency treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three of them at HL, as equivalent to a qualifying examination for a Danish university bachelor once you have added two successive raises in the level of upper-secondary subjects, at least one of them to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag or as a self-study candidate. If you already hold an A-level subject other than Danish, two raises to B level are enough. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the other published route.
requirements.note: If you pay tuition, AAU says you cannot apply in the year you earn your IB: your documentation deadline is 1 May. Non-EU applicants should check whether a residence-based fee exemption applies. The rule is national rather than this university's: the Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science sets which examinations are adgangsgivende, and every Danish institution applies the same one. Two things about it are easy to get wrong. GSK (gymnasial supplering) cannot be used for this — GSK raises a subject level for someone who already holds a qualifying examination, so it meets a specific subject requirement but never raises the level of the examination itself. And the average used in quota 1 is the one from the first qualifying examination, so a Course Results holder who supplements or retakes is still converted on the original Course Results result.

alternativeRouteSummary.short: Course Results of 18+ points (grade 3 in all six, three at HL) count once you raise two subjects a level, one of them to A level. Or retake for the Diploma.

openFor.question: Will you pay tuition? AAU says paying applicants cannot apply in the year they earn the IB because documents are due 1 May. Check whether a residence-based fee exemption applies before planning autumn 2027 entry.

notes: Specialisations chosen during the programme: Industrial Electronics, IT and Cyber Systems.

Current programme requirements read on 29 October 2026; a full 2027 admissions calendar and tuition rates are not yet published. Existing cutoffs and place counts refer to 2026, not a prediction for 2027.
Tuition-paying applicants cannot apply in the year they earn the IB, because documents are due 1 May. Non-EU applicants with a qualifying residence exemption need to establish their fee status.
Published academic-year-2026 tuition for two semesters: DKK 115,700. Application fee EUR 150 unless exempt. EU/EEA tuition and application fee are waived.
